body.objective: Make the resident-agent next-work path self-diagnosing when an agent reports an empty queue because it used the wrong stream name, already holds a lease, confuses a machine stream identifier with the team's scientific role, or the programme contains an invalid second live exclusive lease for the same agent.
body.stop_condition: Land a deterministic read-only `s-f agent status --agent A [--stream S] --now T` (or a documented equivalent) that prints every live/expired lease held by A, the exact resumable item and command, READY depth and next pull in the resolved stream, open requests addressed to that stream, and any programme-health defect. Make `s-f work ready --stream S` distinguish an unknown stream from a known empty stream and suggest close stream names such as `quantum-qme` for `quantum`. Add an optional programme-owned, versioned display-name/alias map whose labels are presentation-only and never alter stream identity, ownership, readiness or routing; use it consistently in overview, streams-view, agent status, generated briefs and Konsole titles while retaining the canonical ID beside it, for example `Einstein/Bridge [bridge]`. Make `work pull` and `work assign` refuse a second live exclusive lease for the same agent across different items with an actionable list of the existing lease and `work show/yield/abort/close` commands. Surface historical multiple-live-lease states as a health finding in overview rather than silently presenting both as ordinary work. Add deterministic fixtures for typo/alias suggestion, ambiguous aliases that fail closed, scientific display names round-tripping to canonical IDs, truly empty known stream, one active lease plus ready successors, stale/expired lease, two cross-item live leases, independent-reproduction exemption, and the current physics reproductions in which `quantum-qme-1` appears to have no work while two active leases and three ready items exist and a user cannot tell that `bridge` is the Einstein/Plebanski-Hacyan team. Preserve explicit timestamps, append-only events and one-lease semantics.
body.current_gate: resident agent status and stream/lease diagnostics
body.forbid: no implicit lease release; no automatic stream alias that can route work without confirmation; no treating an expired lease as live; no hiding invalid historical overlap; no mutation from status/help commands; no weakening independent-reproduction typing; no special case for the quantum stream
activates: reliable resident self-service work resumption across all physics streams
body.resource_hint: SCIENCE FORGE CLI ROBUSTNESS. Reuse the folded agent-to-live-lease index requested by the cross-item CAS fix, the existing deterministic typo-diagnostic command table, and the landed work-show/overview paths; do not introduce a second state fold or a second fuzzy-command engine. notes: Live physics reproduction on 2026-07-21: the Quantum resident reported no work. The authoritative programme had stream `quantum-qme`, three READY items, and two simultaneous ACTIVE exclusive leases for `quantum-qme-1`; one active item also had uncommitted scientific artifacts. The current CLI makes these three causes look like an empty queue to the resident.

Second live reproduction on 2026-07-21: the human coordinator could not tell whether the Classical or Einstein team owned the compactified Plebanski-Hacyan programme because the resident/dashboard name is `bridge`. The canonical stream should remain `bridge`, but all human-facing views should permit the stable scientific label `Einstein/Bridge` and show both names.

This request complements, rather than replaces, bug-science-forge-pull-transition-cas-race. The acquisition guard prevents new overlap; this status surface explains and safely repairs existing or historical overlap.

Coordination audit: deterministic typo suggestions remain owned by bug-science-forge-cli-typo-diagnostics, and process notification remains owned by science-forge-resident-await-and-wakeup. This ticket consumes those interfaces and owns only the unified agent/stream status and presentation surface.

2026-07-21 coordinator paper cut: `s-f work assign` correctly creates only the lease and says `NO work package emitted`, but the resident then needs a discoverable one-command path to recover the complete generated brief for that assigned item. `s-f agent status` should print that exact command, and either `work resume -o`, `work package --item`, or a documented equivalent should emit the same full package as pull without acquiring a second lease or appending a second ACTIVE event.

2026-07-21T07:54Z exact Observer reproduction: observer-1 reported that its lane contained no work while `work show` proved a live exclusive lease on observer-positive-berger-local-receiver-action-preflight through 15:35Z, with its only dependency satisfied and no checkpoint yet. `work ready --stream observer` correctly omitted the already-leased item but provided no incumbent recovery path, so the resident interpreted READY depth zero as an empty lane. The manual recovery is `s-f work-package sf:program/work/observer-positive-berger-local-receiver-action-preflight -o /tmp/observer-current-brief.md`. The requested status command must surface this incumbent before READY depth and print that exact non-mutating package command; `work pull` for the same agent may instead return an idempotent RESUME/package result, but must not append another ACTIVE or LEASE event.

2026-07-21T12:20Z three-lane recurrence: Black Hole, Bridge and Classical simultaneously appeared stuck with valid LIVE coordinator-assigned leases, satisfied dependencies, no missing committed files in their primary source roots and no current-epoch checkpoint. `work assign` had correctly said NO work package emitted; the residents therefore could not recover the pull package by pulling again. The coordinator independently generated complete 88-, 89- and 87-line briefs with `s-f work-package` and sent the exact recovery commands through typed same-stream requests. This confirms the issue is not stream-specific and makes the assign-to-resident acknowledgement/package path a production requirement rather than optional convenience.

2026-07-21T12:36Z observability refinement: all six resident lanes were simultaneously reported as LEASED-UNSTARTED because no current-epoch checkpoint existed, but process inspection showed Black Hole actively running long exact symbolic jobs while Bridge and Classical had not consumed their open package-recovery requests. The status surface therefore needs an explicit resident acknowledgement/heartbeat distinction: ASSIGNED_UNACKNOWLEDGED, ACKNOWLEDGED/EXECUTING, and CHECKPOINTED. A resident `work resume` should acknowledge the assignment, emit the package idempotently, and optionally record a bounded heartbeat without claiming scientific progress. Long-running commands may report their PID/command hash and start time as advisory liveness only; process existence must never count as a certificate, checkpoint, or completion. Overview should separately flag open recovery requests that remain unacknowledged.

2026-07-21T12:41Z Konsole ownership reproduction: the coordinator's own live Codex session was titled `s-f quantum-qme-1 · quantum-phase1-strict-weyl-and-selected-successor-synthesis-v2 (work-assign)` after running read-only coordinator inspection/package commands. This made five live sessions appear to contain two Quantum residents, while DBus process/session inspection showed only one actual Quantum writer; the other was the coordinator. Read-only `overview`, `work show`, `work-package`, `inbox`, status and coordinator assignment operations must never replace the caller's persistent team/role title with the inspected target. Only a resident acquisition/resume/acknowledgement for its own stable agent id may set the resident title. Add a fixture with one coordinator inspecting multiple streams and one real Quantum resident, proving the coordinator title remains byte-identical and the Quantum title changes only in the Quantum session. The coordinator manually restored its title to `s-f coordinator · Phase 1 monitor`; this is a workaround, not the fix.
